subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded media from unmentioned group messages for later mentioned turns, and under which media-kind, TTL, local-path, and context-visibility limits?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes what bystander group attachments can later reach model context, so automation should not choose the privacy and retention boundary by itself.

options.title: Approve bounded local-image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep text-only skipped history
options.body: Preserve the safer current behavior and document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed unless it is part of the current or visible reply turn.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a proposed PR demonstrates the exact Telegram failure and the bounded retention behavior with redacted live proof.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded local-image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared history-media helpers and channel context behavior, and this is the strongest concrete history signal available from the sampled code paths.
